Local distance distortion: coefficient variation ratio embedded original distances 10 nearest neighbors point. 0 embedding preserves distances neighbors common scale (local isometry), whatever scale.
code: # Row-wise ranks of a distance matrix, a point being excluded from its own # neighbors rank_rows <- function(d) {   diag(d) <- Inf   t(apply(d, 1, rank, ties.method = "first")) }  # The similarity transformation (rotation, scaling, translation) of y that # brings it closest to the true coordinates procrustes <- function(y, truth) {   my <- colMeans(y)   mt <- colMeans(truth)   yc <- sweep(y, 2, my)   s <- svd(crossprod(yc, sweep(truth, 2, mt)))   rotation <- s$u %*% t(s$v)   b <- sum(s$d) / sum(yc^2)   function(z) sweep(b * sweep(z, 2, my) %*% rotation, 2, mt, "+") }  rmse <- function(y, truth) sqrt(mean(rowSums((y - truth)^2)))  quality <- function(y, truth, dx, rx, k = 10) {   n <- nrow(y)   dy <- as.matrix(dist(y))   ry <- rank_rows(dy)   near_x <- rx <= k   near_y <- ry <= k   scale <- 2 / (n * k * (2 * n - 3 * k - 1))   ratio <- dy[near_x] / dx[near_x]   c(     rmse = rmse(procrustes(y, truth)(y), truth),     trustworthiness = 1 - scale * sum((rx - k)[near_y & !near_x]),     continuity = 1 - scale * sum((ry - k)[near_x & !near_y]),     distortion = sd(ratio) / mean(ratio)   ) }

code: run <- function(name, problem, seed) {   x <- problem$x   if (name == "Kernel PCA") {     # Keep the kernel width with the best result     sq <- median(dist(x)^2)     fits <- lapply(kernel_grid, function(g) {       time <- system.time(y <- methods[[name]](x, sigma = g / sq))[["elapsed"]]       list(y = y, time = time, sigma = g / sq)     })     errors <- sapply(fits, function(f) rmse(procrustes(f$y, problem$truth)(f$y), problem$truth))     return(fits[[which.min(errors)]])   }   set.seed(seed)   time <- system.time(y <- methods[[name]](x, k = k))[["elapsed"]]   list(y = y, time = time) }  runs <- list() results <- list() for (p in names(problems)) {   problem <- problems[[p]]   dx <- as.matrix(dist(problem$x))   rx <- rank_rows(dx)   for (m in names(methods)) {     for (s in if (is.null(seeds[[m]])) 1 else seeds[[m]]) {       fit <- run(m, problem, s)       runs[[paste(p, m, s, sep = "|")]] <- fit       results[[length(results) + 1]] <- data.frame(         problem = p, method = m, seed = s, time = fit$time,         t(quality(fit$y, problem$truth, dx, rx))       )     }   } } results <- do.call(rbind, results) results$problem <- factor(results$problem, levels = names(problems)) results$method <- factor(results$method, levels = names(methods))
